::: {#rem-cumulative-incidence}

#### Cumulative incidence has a second meaning

The name [cumulative incidence](#def-outcome-risk) for the [risk](#def-outcome-risk) fits a closed [population](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-population), where no one enters or leaves after the start of the time period [@me4, Chapter 4].
The same name is also used for a different quantity: when several event types compete, the cumulative incidence function of one event type at time $t$ is the [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) that this type of event occurs by time $t$ [@me4, Chapter 22]. <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
This page uses the name only for the risk of a [binary](data.qmd#def-binary-var) outcome.

:::
